title: SIFT Approach
summary: Work through Stop, Investigate, Find, and Trace before deciding what a claim deserves.
concept: A four-step investigation with a claim, evidence notes, original source, and an unresolved assessment.

title: PRISM Thinking Coach
summary: Use Patterns, Reasoning, Ideas, Situation, and Methods to move from noticing to explaining.
concept: Five inquiry lenses surround a learner response, with one focused question and a synthesis challenge.

title: Outline Helper
summary: Organize discussion into a traditional outline while keeping decisions distinct from proposals.
concept: Source notes sit beside a Roman numeral outline, with decisions and action items separated below.

title: Quadrant Note-Taking
summary: Connect main ideas to evidence, personal connections, and a short synthesis.
concept: Four labeled writing areas link main ideas, evidence, personal connections, and synthesis, followed by retrieval questions.

title: AI Citation Assistant
summary: Gather real source details, distinguish citation from AI disclosure, and expose missing metadata.
concept: A source-details form leads to citation review and a separate AI-use disclosure, with missing fields visible.

title: Vocabulary Enhancement
summary: Move from word meanings to creative use, retrieval, and a quick check for understanding.
concept: A word and meaning feed a four-panel comic plan, a context sentence, and a retrieval exit ticket.

title: Freewriting Coach
summary: Use FLOW to start writing, keep ideas moving, and reflect before revising.
concept: A quiet writing area pairs a chosen prompt with a pausable timer and optional reflection after writing.

title: Compare Options
summary: Make priorities, constraints, evidence, and uncertainty visible before choosing.
concept: Options appear in a criteria table, with must-haves, unknowns, and a small next test.

title: Source Integrity
summary: Check whether a source supports the actual claim, then record a correction or next check.
concept: A ledger links each claim to its source location, finding, and remaining verification task.
